title: Official Montana general election returns 1928, by county

pages.hint: Read only the 4 rightmost columns of figures, headed Democratic presidential electors; skip every other column. The table runs past the bottom edge, so there is no total row here. Blank or dotted cells are empty strings. The county rows, top to bottom, are Beaverhead, Big Horn, Blaine, Broadwater, Carbon, Carter, Cascade, Chouteau, Custer, Daniels, Dawson, Deer Lodge, Fallon, Fergus, Flathead, Gallatin, Garfield, Glacier, Golden Valley, Granite, Hill, Jefferson, Judith Basin, Lake, Lewis and Clark, Liberty, Lincoln, Madison, McCone; the last may be cut at the bottom edge. Keep each county's figures on its own row, and give an empty row where the columns are blank.
